fluff.overview: Federated Suns infantry benefit from one of the strongest industrial bases in the Inner Sphere, with AFFS quartermasters able to supply platoons with standardized equipment and ammunition from a logistics network that few rival states can match. Mechanized wheeled platoons ride wheeled transports that offer good speed on roads and developed terrain, making them well-suited to garrison duty on worlds with established infrastructure where rapid response matters more than cross-country capability. Carrying medium recoilless rifles that fire shaped-charge warheads, these platoons field crew-served weapons heavy enough to threaten armored vehicles at ranges beyond what personal arms can achieve.
